thesisQuality.note: Exceptional contracted AI-infrastructure demand supports the thesis, while leverage, concentration and execution dependence cap conviction.

financialOperatingMomentum.note: Q2 issuer evidence shows rapid revenue/backlog expansion and continued infrastructure scaling.

marketValuationOpportunity.note: Independent Sep. 17 market data shows a large enterprise value relative to current revenue and negative trailing earnings, limiting valuation margin of safety.

catalystScore.note: Large backlog, >$25B early-Q3 commitments and active-power expansion create identifiable near- and medium-term conversion catalysts.

governancePower.note: Demonstrated access to large-scale financing supports execution capacity, but debt-heavy capital formation warrants a conservative governance/capital-allocation assessment.

alignment2036.note: The issuer is directly building GPU-heavy AI compute infrastructure and power capacity required for continued AI scaling.

crossDivisionLeverage.note: Integrated compute infrastructure, data-center capacity and cloud service delivery allow contracted demand to leverage the same operating platform.

bottleneckControl.note: Secured compute and power capacity provide meaningful exposure to AI infrastructure bottlenecks, but upstream GPU/power suppliers remain outside CoreWeave control.

scenarioRobustness.note: Large backlog supports demand visibility, but financing conditions, deployment timing and utilization create material downside sensitivity.

substitutionResilience.note: Contracted infrastructure and specialized deployment create some stickiness, while hyperscalers and competing AI clouds remain credible substitutes.

supplyChainResilience.note: Large financing access supports procurement, but rapid expansion remains dependent on GPUs, power and data-center delivery, making resilience below average.

pricingPower.note: Large contracted commitments indicate customers accept substantial capacity economics, but exact contract pricing and renewal economics remain opaque.

risk1.note: Very high capital intensity, debt dependence, negative trailing earnings, GPU/power supply dependence, customer concentration and backlog-conversion conditions materially elevate risk.

confidence.note: Current issuer backlog and financing evidence plus independent market valuation support reproducible treatment; full contract economics and customer concentration remain documented non-gating unknowns.

thesis: CoreWeave is a direct AI-compute infrastructure beneficiary with exceptional contracted demand, but its economics are inseparable from aggressive capital formation and GPU/power availability.
keyRisk: Leverage and capital intensity can overwhelm backlog growth if deployment timing, utilization, customer concentration or financing conditions deteriorate.
nextCatalyst: Q3 2026 backlog conversion, financing cost and active-power deployment progress.
